name: V-App
summary: Perth dialup (later ADSL) ISP, special rates for UWA Graduates Association (V-App Pty Ltd, by 2001); defunct (INTERNET DEVELOPMENT & CONSULTING SERVICES PTY LTD, ACN 095 674 338).

events.details: Defunct. Company cancelled 30 Jun 2005, branding lingered to early 2006, Concept Networks took the domain over by 2007 - c. 2005 verified; brief 'c. 2005' and proposal align.

refs.label: Operating company cancelled 30 Jun 2005 (Perth - matches v-App's WA focus).
v-App branding still present at the nearest capture to 1 Jan 2006.
By Aug 2007 the domain serves Concept Networks (copyright 2005), so the v-App brand turned over c. 2005-06.
